description: This policy will allow camera mode to be managed by IT admins and enable camera to run in safe or auto share mode.

options.displayName: AutoShare - Allow camera access by multiple applications simultaneously.
options.description: AutoShare - Allow camera access by multiple applications simultaneously.

options.displayName: SafeMode - The camera is configured to auto‑share and operate in a non‑accelerated mode, bypassing OEM/IHV‑provided plugins where applicable.
